fx.name: droste
fx.label: Droste Tunnel
fx.description: Repeats the picture inside itself as an endless zooming spiral.

fx.name: shockwave
fx.label: Shockwave
fx.description: A ripple ring fired by the beat. Without audio it uses the interval.

fx.name: heat_haze
fx.label: Heat Haze & Caustic Light
fx.description: Rising heat shimmer, dancing underwater light nets, or both.

fx.name: rgb_echo
fx.label: RGB Time Echo
fx.description: Each colour channel lags behind by a different amount, so moving shapes leave rainbow echoes.

fx.name: slit_scan
fx.label: Slit-Scan Time Warp
fx.description: Only a thin slit (or ring) shows the live picture; the past scrolls away from it, stretching time into space.

fx.name: datamosh
fx.label: Datamosh
fx.description: Broken-video smearing: blocks drag the old picture along, until a refresh on the beat snaps it back.

fx.name: color_wash
fx.label: Acid Colours
fx.description: Rolls the hues across the picture in waves.

fx.name: vision
fx.label: Vision Modes
fx.description: See the scene through a thermal camera, night-vision goggles, an X-ray or infrared film.

fx.name: oil_paint
fx.label: Oil Paint
fx.description: Kuwahara filter: flattens colour into brush strokes, like a painting.

fx.name: relief
fx.label: Relief Lighting
fx.description: Treats brightness as height and lights it, so the image looks sculpted in clay, chrome or gold.

fx.name: holo_foil
fx.label: Holo Foil
fx.description: Rainbow foil like a holographic card: colours shift with the slope of the image, with glints.

fx.name: pixel_sort
fx.label: Pixel Sort
fx.description: Glitch-art streaks: runs of pixels within the brightness band are sorted or smeared along a direction.

fx.name: stained_glass
fx.label: Stained Glass
fx.description: Turns the image into a lit stained-glass window: irregular glass pieces with lead lines.

fx.name: watercolour
fx.label: Watercolour
fx.description: Paints the image in watercolour: colours bleed, pigment pools at edges, paper grain shows through.

fx.name: tilt_shift
fx.label: Focus Blur
fx.description: Tilt-shift miniature look, or a radial focus spot.

fx.name: god_rays
fx.label: God Rays
fx.description: Light shafts streaming from bright areas toward the light point.

fx.name: anamorphic
fx.label: Anamorphic Flare
fx.description: Cinematic horizontal lens streaks and ghosts from the highlights.

fx.name: ascii
fx.label: ASCII Text Mode
fx.description: Redraws the picture with text characters, like an old terminal.

fx.name: dither
fx.label: Retro Dither
fx.description: Ordered (Bayer) dithering with retro palettes: 1-bit Mac, Game Boy, CGA, amber monitor, Pico-8.

overlays.label: Strobe
overlays.hint: Sync it to kicks or beats below; without audio it uses the period.

overlays.label: Lightning
overlays.hint: Bolts fire on the chosen hit; Free Run strikes at random.

overlays.label: Fireworks
overlays.hint: Rockets and bursts fired on the chosen hit; Free Run launches at random.

overlays.label: 3D Laser Room
overlays.hint: Laser beams in 3D perspective: tunnels of rings, fanned sheets, criss-crossing beams or a laser grid, in hazy air.

overlays.label: Pulse Rings
overlays.hint: Expanding rings, fired on the beat or on a timer.

overlays.label: Plexus
overlays.hint: Drifting points joined by lines whenever they come close.

overlays.label: Tron Hex Grid
overlays.hint: A glowing hexagon grid, flat or as a floor; pulses ripple out from the centre on the chosen hit.

overlays.label: Sacred Geometry
overlays.hint: Sacred geometry that draws itself line by line in time with the music, holds, then fades and starts again.

overlays.label: Bokeh Lights
overlays.hint: Soft out-of-focus lights drifting in front of the scene; they flare on the chosen hit.

overlays.label: Matrix Rain
overlays.hint: Falling columns of glyphs; the chosen hit drops a new wave of streams and flashes the heads.

overlays.label: Cinematic
overlays.hint: Widescreen letterbox bars, warm film-burn flares and dips to black, like a movie.

overlays.label: Spectrum Visualizer
overlays.hint: Shows the live audio from the Audio tab source.

overlays.label: Lyrics / Text Sequence
overlays.hint: Your lines, one after another, changing on the beat or the bar. Write one line per row.

params.name: ly_lines
params.label: Lines (one per row)
params.default:
FEEL THE BEAT
LET IT FLOW
INTO THE LIGHT
WE ARE ONE

overlays.label: Image / Logo
overlays.hint: Your own picture or logo on top (PNG with transparency works best). It pulses on the kick.
